item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 26/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will bring cool weather to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will cover southern China. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. Temperatures will fall over the region.

Date/Month: 26/02 (Monday)
Wind: North force 4. Becoming east to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
